name: Adam
role: First man, called Michael and the Ancient of Days
dateNote: The D&C says he blessed his posterity at Adam-ondi-Ahman three years before his death.
importance: Section 27 names him “Michael, or Adam, the father of all”. Section 29 recounts his temptation and fall and says God gave him and his seed time to repent. Section 107 says the priesthood order began in his day and lists the patriarchs he ordained. It also tells of his final blessing at Adam-ondi-Ahman, and section 116 says he will return there.
connections: The D&C names his sons Abel and Seth and his descendant Enoch. In sections 137 and 138 Joseph Smith and Joseph F. Smith report seeing “Father Adam”.
reviewNote: Described only as the D&C presents him. “Michael” is included because the D&C identifies Michael with Adam (27:11, 107:54); 88:112–115 uses Michael as the archangel. The place name Adam-ondi-Ahman contains “Adam” and should not be linked to him.
